label: Documentation site
description: Markdown docs with a getting-started guide, built into a static site.
task: Set up a documentation site in this empty folder. Write the pages in Markdown under docs/: index.md (what this is and who it is for), getting-started.md (install and a first example), guides/ with one how-to page, and reference.md with a skeleton to fill in. Build it with VitePress: package.json with the scripts docs:dev, docs:build and docs:preview, and docs/.vitepress/config.mts with the navigation and sidebar for these pages. Add a test script that checks every relative Markdown link points to a page that exists. Add a .gitignore for node_modules and the build output, and a README.md that says how to write a page, preview the site and build it.

create.note: VitePress asks a few questions. Run it in the new folder before you press Run; the run then builds on what it created.
